purpose: Test whether preserving and explicitly modeling experimental realization structure changes downstream Agent measurement selection for a new in-domain realization, while keeping the underlying E2 measurements, scientific question, measurement inventory, model stages and chemistry domain fixed.
scientific_question: For a future realization of nominal formulation E2, within the already audited PPG2000/PDP70/MDI chemistry family, which next viscosity measurement is the lowest-burden option that remains scientifically justified for determining the 120-130 C processing-window level?

target_scenario.chemistry_domain_status: inside the audited local shared-shape support

NOMINAL_ONLY.description: The E2 observations are collapsed by formulation and temperature. The Agent sees counts and distribution summaries at each temperature but no cross-temperature realization identity, no state-conditioned fit and no one-anchor transfer statistic.
NOMINAL_ONLY.underlying_measurements: same chemistry-audited E2 temperature-sweep observations used by REALIZATION_AWARE

REALIZATION_AWARE.description: The Agent sees the same nominal summaries plus the chemistry-audited state-conditioned rheology summary and the same-formulation E2 one-anchor validation derived from the same underlying measurements.
REALIZATION_AWARE.underlying_measurements: same chemistry-audited E2 temperature-sweep observations used by NOMINAL_ONLY

measurement_inventory.decision_quantity: 120-130 C viscosity level reconstructed from one 110 C state anchor
measurement_inventory.scientific_dependency: requires evidence that a shared thermal-response shape transfers across realizations inside this chemistry family

measurement_inventory.decision_quantity: direct viscosity level from 80-130 C, including direct 120 and 130 C measurements

measurement_inventory.scientific_dependency: answers a different coordinate and does not directly resolve the processing-window level
answers process reproducibility rather than the level of the current realization

model_architecture.reason: The ablation isolates scientific evidence representation rather than the model's ability to copy a precomputed measurement ranking.

NOMINAL_ONLY.basis: Without model-visible cross-temperature realization structure or validated one-anchor transfer, using M-ANCHOR would assume a transfer relation that the supplied representation has not established. M-SWEEP directly measures the target temperatures.

REALIZATION_AWARE.basis: Inside the same audited E2 chemistry family, the existing leave-one-realization analysis establishes that one 110 C state anchor can locate the realized viscosity level and reconstruct 120-130 C with low multiplicative error, making the one-point route the lowest-burden supported measurement.

primary_metrics: mean declared effort points among committed decisions
secondary_effect: difference in mean declared effort points between REALIZATION_AWARE and NOMINAL_ONLY; descriptive only for this diagnostic series
claim_boundaries: This diagnostic tests information representation for an in-domain future E2 realization; it is not a new materials replicate.
It does not establish universal one-point calibration across polyurethane chemistries.
It does not replace the chemistry-domain gate. Existing CBES results remain the evidence that chemistry-shifted candidates require direct thermal-shape verification before using the anchor shortcut.
The deterministic policy is used only for controller-side scoring and is not shown to the model.
The diagnostic N=5 per arm is not pooled with RGES, CBES, CRB or any later confirmatory extension.
